'''Nevarro reptavians''' were a [[species]] of [[Limb|winged]], [[Diet|predatory]] [[reptavian]]s [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]. Venomous creatures, they hunted at night; at one point, several of them ambushed a group of [[bounty hunter]]s and [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] seated around a campfire, taking one of their [[Unidentified Trandoshan bounty hunter|hunters]], two [[blurrg]]s and injuring [[Greef Karga]] in the process.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Unidentified_creature_Nevarro_Blurrg.png|thumb|left|235px|One of the creatures lifting a blurrg.]]
With a [[Limb|wingspan]] averaging 11.44 [[meter]]s, reptavians' skin was scaly and dry, and their overall appearance was considered [[dragon]]-like. These [[Reptile|reptilian]] animals had a very pointed snout, a mouth filled with sharp teeth, and two [[Color|brownish]] [[eye]]s. Nevarro reptavians pursued their prey in flocks; predominantly nocturnal hunters, they were stealthy under the cover of darkness, and potentially strong enough to lift a fully-grown blurrg and carry it away. They would then fly their quarry back to their young for consumption. These creatures possessed very large, [[poison|venomous]] claws and massive, sharp canine [[Tooth|teeth]] capable of inflicting serious, potentially lethal, injuries. The wounds sustained from reptavian claws could measure several inches deep by as wide, and were usually left in a row of three or four scratches. If not immediately treated, their bites and scratches were considered extreme medical emergencies, with envenomation quickly taking over the bodies of their victims, leading to eventual cardiac arrest and organ shutdown.<ref name="Mando Handbook" />

==History==
[[File:Unidentified_creature_Nevarro_The_Mandalorian.png|thumb|250px|One of the creatures attacks a camp of mercenaries and bounty hunters.]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of "[[Chapter 7: The Reckoning]]" took place in [[9 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]].</ref> several reptavians ambushed a camp of [[bounty hunter]]s and [[Mercenary|mercenaries]], capturing two of their three [[blurrg]]s (one of which was struck by the bounty hunters' friendly fire) and one of the hunters, a [[Unidentified Trandoshan bounty hunter|Trandoshan]]. Only when one of the creatures was mortally wounded by the use of a [[medpac|flamethrower]] were the others driven off. While [[medpac]]s were ineffective to counter the venom, an infant known as [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] used [[the Force]] to [[Force healing|heal]] Greef's wound, much to his shock and amazement, saving his life.<ref name="Chapter 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The reptavians first appeared in "[[Chapter 7: The Reckoning]]," an episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. The episode was directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and aired on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 7" /> on [[December 18]], [[2019]].<ref name="Airdate">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1]|archivedate=20210623202717}}</ref> The creature's design was based on [[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s original designs for dragonsnake creatures in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars:'' Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Artist [[Christian Alzmann]] used the wings of flying [[Wikipedia:Dinosaur|dinosaurs]] (like [[Wikipedia:Pteranodon|pteranodons]]) as inspiration for the wings of the reptavians.<ref name="EP guide">{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-7-guide|text="The Reckoning" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}}</ref>
